name: Sync to video (ffsubsync)
description: Re-times this subtitle so it matches the attached video's speech.
install:
ffsubsync re-times a subtitle against the video's speech.
Install:
  macOS:   brew install ffmpeg ; pip install ffsubsync
  Linux:   sudo apt install ffmpeg ; pip install ffsubsync
  Windows: install ffmpeg, then  pip install ffsubsync
Make sure 'ffsubsync' is on your PATH (or pick it with Browse).

params.label: Large offset search
params.help: Use golden-section search (--gss) when the offset is large or unknown

name: Sync to another subtitle (ffsubsync)
description: Re-times this subtitle to match a correctly-timed reference subtitle open in another window.
install:
ffsubsync re-times a subtitle against a correctly-timed reference subtitle (another open window).
Install:
  macOS:   brew install ffmpeg ; pip install ffsubsync
  Linux:   sudo apt install ffmpeg ; pip install ffsubsync
  Windows: install ffmpeg, then  pip install ffsubsync

params.label: Reference subtitle
params.help: The correctly-timed subtitle window to sync against

params.label: Large offset search

name: Sync to video (alass)
description: Re-times this subtitle against the attached video, correcting offset, framerate drift and scene splits.
install:
alass re-times a subtitle against the video, handling offset, framerate drift and scene splits.
Install:
  macOS/Linux: build from source (github.com/kaegi/alass) or use a package (AUR: alass).
  Windows:     download the prebuilt alass-cli.exe.
Make sure the binary ('alass' or 'alass-cli') is on your PATH (or pick it with Browse).
